SHENSHEN-I_DONT_LIKE_YOU.title: I Don't Like You!
SHENSHEN-I_DONT_LIKE_YOU.description:
[gold]Girl form.[/gold]
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Repeat:diff()} times.
Gain {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
The enemy gains {EnemyStrength:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
SHENSHEN-LIGHT_MIRROR.title: Light Mirror
SHENSHEN-LIGHT_MIRROR.description:
[gold]Girl form.[/gold]
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Until your next turn, reflect damage blocked from attacks back to the attacker.
Repeated casts do not multiply or extend reflection.
SHENSHEN-TRANSFORMATION_MAGIC.title: Transformation Magic
SHENSHEN-TRANSFORMATION_MAGIC.descriptio:
Switch between girl and cat form.
Discard your current form's cards from hand, then draw that many cards from your owned new form deck.
Return this card to your hand.
SHENSHEN-LIGHT_BLESSING.title: Light Blessing
SHENSHEN-LIGHT_BLESSING.description:
[gold]Girl form.[/gold]
Bless another player. Before their next normal draw, they choose {Cards:diff()} extra cards from their draw pile to add to hand.
SHENSHEN-FLUFFED_UP.title: Fluffed Up
SHENSHEN-FLUFFED_UP.description:
[gold]Cat form.[/gold]
After activation, gain 3 [gold]Thorns[/gold] the first time you lose HP to an enemy attack this combat; gain 1 on each later hit.
Also gain 1 [gold]Thorns[/gold] for each different debuff an enemy successfully applies.
Persists across forms. Additional copies do not stack or reset the first-hit reward.
